en.topic_summary:
China’s economy grew slightly more than expected in the third quarter, but Monday’s figures still came in at the lower end of the government’s full-year target, as the global energy shock and weak domestic demand counter surging exports.



A container terminal. File photo: GovHK. 



The world’s second-largest economy has charted a diverging path in recent years, with an AI-fuelled export boom masking the impact of a persistent real estate crisis and gloomy consumer sent
